messages:
maria-cs: Alert: onboarding delays for tenants created during last night's EU index migration. ~15 tenants impacted (mostly trials, 3 high-touch). Need customer comms, translations, and credit recommendation.

ashley-se: Pls DM list + 1-line RCA for the note. ETA to full recovery?

maria-cs: DM sent. RCA: indexer backlog + aggressive retry policy triggered rate-limit during migration traffic.

sam-eng: Mitigations: added indexer capacity, relaxed retry backoff, temporarily widened limiter window. Queue depth falling; expected catch-up 25-40m.

neil-ops: Deployed limiter tweak at 17:18 UTC. Backfill started; 10/15 tenants complete. Monitoring.

lina-localization: I can return FR/DE/ES translations in ~20m once you finalize copy.

maria-cs: Draft outbound below (will localize). Please review.

"Subject: Update: onboarding delay during EU migration — remediation & offer"

Hi <Customer name>,

We experienced a provisioning delay for customers onboarded during a recent EU migration. Our engineers have implemented a fix and your tenant's index should be available shortly.

What we did: increased processing capacity, adjusted provisioning retries, and monitored backlog until caught up.
What we're offering: 1 week of platform credits (2 weeks for high-touch customers) and a 1:1 office-hours slot if you'd like guided help. Reply if you need a prioritized import.

We'll follow up with a short post-incident summary and a feedback link.

Best,
Redwood Customer Success & Ops

sam-eng: small log snippet for RCA: `2026-03-23T17:12:09Z provisioning.worker INFO attempt=7 tenant=tenant-441 err=\"rate_limited\"`

maria-cs: Plan: individualized outreach to 3 high-touch within 45m; bulk localized message to trials after translations. Will post final status here in 30m and RCA in ~24h.
